identity_scope: The complete dye3 and dye4 graphs retain the E imine and phenolate charge−1, singlet reference state. Dye3 contains a nitrothiophene terminus, whereas dye4 contains a nitrophenyl terminus; their formulas differ. The experiments generate the anions in situ with tetrabutylammonium hydroxide in methanol. A bare-anion model excludes experimental components by approximation; the actual solution is not declared counterion-free. Study the lower-energy band in the three supplied solvents. Broader solvent inversion thresholds, device behaviour and full photodegradation kinetics are outside the required scope.
